passage.label: Say O disbelievers; not worship what worship; nor you worshippers what I worship; nor I worshipper what worshipped

mainSubject.label: The Prophet commanded to address the disbelievers declaring that he does not worship what they worship, nor are they worshippers of what he worships, nor is he a worshipper of what they have worshipped

subordinateSubjects.label: Command to address the disbelievers directly
I do not worship what you worship
Nor are you worshippers of what I worship
Nor am I a worshipper of what you have worshipped

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Absolute theological disavowal expressed through four-fold negation

relationships.label: Mutual worship-incompatibility declared between the Prophet and the disbelievers

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the past-tense non-worship declaration (4) before the future-tense non-worship and closing separation statement opens (5-6); P2 covers the two-verse closing pair completing the mutual disavowal and religious separation.
